target.title: feat: AI safety event taxonomy — core event contracts
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
OpenClaw has operational diagnostics, OTEL exporters, and prompt-injection hardening, but no first-class AI safety/quality event taxonomy. Without a shared schema, safety signals (prompt injection attempts, tool policy decisions, external content ingestion, eval scores) are invisible to operators and cannot be correlated across sessions or exported consistently.

## Evidence
- `src/infra/diagnostic-events.ts` — `DiagnosticSecurityEvent.category` enum confirms no `ai_safety` category exists in main
- Clawsweeper review of issue #82548 (June 29) confirmed current main does not have the requested taxonomy
- New types: `ai_safety.prompt_injection.signal`, `ai_safety.tool_policy.decision`, `ai_safety.external_content.consumed`, `ai_safety.user_feedback.received`, `ai_safety.memory_context.selected`, `ai_safety.eval.result`
- 8 unit tests added in `src/infra/diagnostic-events.test.ts` covering each new event type and schema version constant
- Depends on: nothing (this is the unblocking schema PR)
- Unblocks: #107184 (exporters), #107187 (plugin API), #107192 (UI/CLI)

## Evidence — Clawsweeper re-review fixes (2026-07-14)

**Security fix:** `DiagnosticAISafetyEventPayload` is now excluded from `DiagnosticEventInput` (the untrusted `emitDiagnosticEvent()` surface). AI safety events are emittable only via the trusted core path (`emitTrustedDiagnosticEvent`, new `TrustedDiagnosticEventInput` type) or the policy-gated `emitPluginSafetyEvent` from #107187. A runtime gate mirroring the existing `security.event` gate additionally drops any `ai_safety.*` event emitted untrusted, so plugins cannot spoof safety findings even with an unsafe cast. Contract tests moved to `src/infra/diagnostic-ai-safety-events.test.ts` and now cover the untrusted-drop behavior:

```
✓ diagnostic AI safety events > exports AI_SAFETY_EVENT_SCHEMA_VERSION as numeric constant 1
✓ diagnostic AI safety events > drops AI safety events emitted through the untrusted emitDiagnosticEvent API
✓ diagnostic AI safety events > emits ai_safety.prompt_injection.signal with required fields via trusted path
✓ diagnostic AI safety events > emits ai_safety.prompt_injection.signal without optional fields
✓ diagnostic AI safety events > emits ai_safety.tool_policy.decision with all fields
✓ diagnostic AI safety events > emits ai_safety.external_content.consumed with hashed URL only
✓ diagnostic AI safety events > emits ai_safety.user_feedback.received with normalized score
✓ diagnostic AI safety events > emits ai_safety.memory_context.selected with item count and tokens
✓ diagnostic AI safety events > emits ai_safety.eval.result with pass/fail and score
✓ diagnostic AI safety events > all six AI safety event types carry standard seq/ts enrichment

Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  10 passed (10)
```

**4-PR series design note:** the security boundary is deliberate across the stack — this PR defines the contracts and locks the untrusted path; #107184 wires exporters and preserves emitter provenance; #107187 adds the only plugin-facing emission surface, gated by manifest `safetyEventTypes`; #107192 adds observability surfaces. Untrusted path gated, trusted path only.

**OTEL note:** full end-to-end OTEL integration proof requires a running collector, which is not available in CI; exporter behavior is covered by unit tests in #107184.

### Live simulation output

<summary>Terminal output — emitting all 6 event types through trusted path (re-run 2026-07-14 after rebase onto upstream/main)</summary>

Run: `npx tsx scripts/simulate-ai-safety-events.ts` on `feat/ai-safety-exporters` (script committed in that branch). Stages: trusted emit → dispatcher fan-out → spoof-resistance gate (untrusted emissions dropped) → OTEL exporter recorders.

```

  dispatch → ai_safety.tool_policy.decision (seq=2, trusted=true)
  dispatch → ai_safety.external_content.consumed (seq=3, trusted=true)
  dispatch → ai_safety.user_feedback.received (seq=4, trusted=true)
  dispatch → ai_safety.memory_context.selected (seq=5, trusted=true)
  dispatch → ai_safety.eval.result (seq=6, trusted=true)

--- Stage 3: spoof-resistance gate (untrusted plugin path) ---
  untrusted emit → ai_safety.prompt_injection.signal ... submitted
  untrusted emit → ai_safety.tool_policy.decision ... submitted
  untrusted emit → ai_safety.external_content.consumed ... submitted
  untrusted emit → ai_safety.user_feedback.received ... submitted
  untrusted emit → ai_safety.memory_context.selected ... submitted
  untrusted emit → ai_safety.eval.result ... submitted
  result: 0/6 untrusted ai_safety.* events reached the dispatcher (expected 0 — dropped by anti-spoofing gate)

      openclaw.ai_safety.emitter_trusted = "true"
      openclaw.ai_safety.severity = "warn"

      openclaw.ai_safety.action_taken = "flagged"
      openclaw.ai_safety.source_type = "tool_output"
      openclaw.ai_safety.channel = "whatsapp"
  otel counter openclaw.ai_safety.tool_policy.decision += 1
      openclaw.ai_safety.emitter_trusted = "true"
      openclaw.ai_safety.tool_name = "bash"
      openclaw.ai_safety.decision = "approval_required"
      openclaw.ai_safety.policy_source = "static_config"
      openclaw.ai_safety.severity = "warn"
      openclaw.ai_safety.channel = "whatsapp"
  otel counter openclaw.ai_safety.external_content.consumed += 1
      openclaw.ai_safety.emitter_trusted = "true"
      openclaw.ai_safety.source_type = "web_fetch"
      openclaw.ai_safety.trusted = "false"
      openclaw.ai_safety.channel = "whatsapp"
  otel counter openclaw.ai_safety.user_feedback.received += 1
      openclaw.ai_safety.emitter_trusted = "true"
      openclaw.ai_safety.label = "correction"
      openclaw.ai_safety.channel = "whatsapp"
  otel counter openclaw.ai_safety.memory_context.selected += 1
      openclaw.ai_safety.emitter_trusted = "true"
      openclaw.ai_safety.memory_type = "long_term"
      openclaw.ai_safety.channel = "whatsapp"
  otel counter openclaw.ai_safety.eval.result += 1
      openclaw.ai_safety.emitter_trusted = "true"
      openclaw.ai_safety.eval_name = "source-trust-check"
      openclaw.ai_safety.passed = "true"
      openclaw.ai_safety.severity = "info"
      openclaw.ai_safety.channel = "whatsapp"

All 6 events emitted through trusted path.
Dispatcher fan-out observed for 6/6 trusted events.
Spoof-resistance verified: 0/6 untrusted emissions dispatched.
Privacy fields verified: snippetHash and urlHash are sha256 — no raw content, and
neither hash appears in OTEL exporter attributes (leak check: passed).
```
</details>
